description: This file defines classes and functions for monitoring and intercepting network requests in Firefox, including handling request/response events, request interception, redirect handling, and response storage, as part of Mozilla's internal network monitoring infrastructure.

classes.name: PageNetwork
classes.description: Represents network activity for a specific page target, manages request interception, headers, and event emission.

classes.name: NetworkRequest
classes.description: Represents an individual network request, handles interception, response data collection, and event emission.

classes.name: NetworkObserver
classes.description: Singleton class that observes network activity, manages request lifecycle, redirects, and integrates with Firefox's networking components.

classes.name: ResponseStorage
classes.description: Stores response bodies with size limits, supports retrieval of base64-encoded response data.

methods.name: forPageTarget
methods.description: Returns or creates a PageNetwork instance for a given target.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers to be included in requests.

methods.name: combinedExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Returns combined headers from target and internal headers.

methods.name: enableRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables request interception.

methods.name: disableRequestInterception
methods.description: Disables request interception and resumes intercepted requests.

methods.name: resumeInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Resumes a intercepted request with specified parameters.

methods.name: fulfillInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Fulfills an intercepted request with specified response data.

methods.name: abortInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Aborts an intercepted request with an error code.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Retrieves the response body for a request as base64.

methods.name: _takeIntercepted
methods.description: Removes and returns an intercepted request by requestId.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a NetworkRequest instance, sets up request interception, headers, and event listeners.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a request with optional URL, method, headers, and postData.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a request with an error code.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a request with status, headers, and body.

methods.name: _onInternalRedirect
methods.description: Handles internal redirect of a request.

methods.name: _onInternalRedirectReady
methods.description: Prepares a request after a resumed internal redirect.

methods.name: getInterface
methods.description: Provides requested XPCOM interface, mainly for authentication and interception control.

methods.name: getAuthPrompt
methods.description: Returns the auth prompt interface.

methods.name: asyncPromptAuth
methods.description: Asynchronously prompts for authentication.

methods.name: promptAuth
methods.description: Provides credentials for authentication if available.

methods.name: shouldPrepareForIntercept
methods.description: Determines if a request should be prepared for interception.

methods.name: channelIntercepted
methods.description: Handles a channel that has been intercepted.

methods.name: onDataAvailable
methods.description: Handles incoming data chunks for a request.

methods.name: onStartRequest
methods.description: Handles start of a request.

methods.name: onStopRequest
methods.description: Handles end of a request, processes response or errors.

methods.name: _shouldIntercept
methods.description: Checks if request should be intercepted based on settings.

methods.name: _sendOnRequest
methods.description: Emits a request event with request details.

methods.name: _sendOnResponse
methods.description: Emits a response event with response details.

methods.name: _sendOnRequestFailed
methods.description: Emits a request failed event.

methods.name: _sendOnRequestFinished
methods.description: Emits a request finished event.

methods.name: _onRedirect
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirect events.

methods.name: _onRequest
methods.description: Handles new request events.

methods.name: _onResponse
methods.description: Handles response events.

methods.name: _onServiceWorkerResponse
methods.description: Handles responses fulfilled by service worker.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and observers.
